question: What is the annual learning budget for individual contributors at Halcyra Biotech?
answer: Individual contributors have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Learning and Development Budgets
sources.text:
Halcyra Biotech wants every employee to keep learning. Each division receives an annual learning and development budget, which can be used for courses, conferences, professional certifications, books and online learning subscriptions that relate to the employee's current role or agreed development plan.

Individual budgets in Research and Development. In the Research and Development division, individual contributors have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500 and people managers have an annual learning budget of EUR 2,100. The higher amount for managers is intended to cover leadership training in addition to scientific development.

Other divisions. Budgets for Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial and Corporate Functions are set each January by the division head and published on that division's intranet page. They are not individual allowances, so employees should agree any spending with their manager before booking.

Budgets run with the calendar year. Unused budget does not carry over to the following year and cannot be transferred to a colleague.

Approval and payment. Requests up to EUR 500 can be approved by your manager. Requests above EUR 500, and any request involving travel outside the EU, also need approval from the division's learning partner. Wherever possible, the Learning team pays the provider directly so that you do not have to claim the cost back.

If an employee leaves Halcyra within 12 months of completing a course that cost more than EUR 2,000, they may be asked to repay part of the cost, as set out in the training agreement signed before booking.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Tuition Support for Degree Programmes
sources.text:
Tuition support is separate from the divisional learning and development budgets. It helps employees who want to complete a longer qualification, such as a part-time bachelor's or master's degree, a doctorate, or a chartered professional qualification that takes more than a year to complete.

Employees with at least 12 months of service and a current performance rating of 'meets expectations' or above can apply. Halcyra will cover up to 75% of tuition fees, to a maximum of EUR 6,000 per academic year, for a qualification that is relevant to the employee's career at Halcyra. Fees for resits, late registration, accommodation and travel are not covered.

Applications are reviewed twice a year, in March and September, by a panel that includes a representative from People and a senior leader from the applicant's division. The panel considers business relevance, the employee's development plan and the funding available.

Employees who receive tuition support sign an agreement that requires them to repay part of the fees if they leave Halcyra within two years of completing the qualification, or if they withdraw from the programme without good reason.

Tuition support is paid directly to the institution at the start of each academic year.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Conference Attendance and Presenting
sources.text:
Attending scientific conferences is an important part of how Halcyra researchers share and learn. This page explains how attendance is organised. The cost of attending is normally paid from the relevant learning and development budget, unless you are presenting.

If you have had an abstract, poster or talk accepted, the Scientific Communications team will pay your registration fee, travel and accommodation from the central communications budget, so the trip does not reduce your learning budget. Send the acceptance letter to Scientific Communications at least six weeks before the event.

Before presenting any Halcyra data externally, you must get clearance from the Publication Review Board. The board meets every two weeks and needs the final slides or poster at least ten working days before the event.

To avoid too many colleagues attending the same event, no more than four employees from one department may attend a single conference unless a director agrees otherwise. Attendees are expected to share a short summary of what they learned with their team within a month of returning.

Travel to conferences is booked through the travel portal and follows the standard business travel policy.

question: Can Tamberlyn staff finish early on Fridays?
answer: Employees may finish work at 1 pm on Fridays without using annual leave.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Flexi-Time Scheme
sources.text:
Most office-based roles at Tamberlyn are part of the flexi-time scheme. Under the scheme you can choose when to start and finish work within a bandwidth of 7:30 am to 7 pm, as long as you are at work during the core hours of 10 am to 12 noon and 2 pm to 4 pm from Monday to Thursday, and 10 am to 12 noon on Fridays.

Hours are recorded in the Timesheets section of the staff portal and balanced over a four-week accounting period. You may carry a credit of up to 15 hours, or a debit of up to 7 hours, from one accounting period to the next. Any credit above 15 hours at the end of a period is lost unless your manager agreed in advance that the extra hours were needed.

With your manager's approval, you can use flexi credit to take up to two full flexi days in each accounting period. Half flexi days can be taken in the morning or the afternoon.

Neighbourhood officers, repairs operatives and contact centre staff work to rotas and are not part of the flexi-time scheme. Their working arrangements are set out in their contracts.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Summer Working Hours 2026
sources.text:
Tamberlyn Housing Association is running its summer working hours scheme again this year to give colleagues more time to rest during the long days of summer.

Between 5 June and 28 August 2026, employees may finish work at 1 pm on Fridays without using annual leave. Outside this period, normal working hours apply, and an early finish on a Friday must be covered by annual leave or flexi-time in the usual way.

Contracted hours do not change. Employees will be paid in full for the Friday afternoons they do not work, and they are not expected to make up the time on other days. Employees who do not normally work on a Friday do not receive an early finish on another day instead.

If an early-finish Friday falls on a day when an employee is on annual leave or off sick, it cannot be moved to another day. Teams should only arrange Friday afternoon meetings during the scheme where they are essential.

During the scheme, calls to the tenant contact centre after 1 pm on Fridays will be answered by our contracted out-of-hours service, and emergency repairs will be handled by the usual on-call contractors. Tenants were told about the change in the June newsletter.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Annual Leave and Bank Holidays
sources.text:
Full-time employees at Tamberlyn receive 26 days of annual leave a year, rising by one day for each complete year of service to a maximum of 31 days, plus the eight bank holidays. Part-time employees receive a pro-rata entitlement calculated in hours.

The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Leave must be requested through the staff portal and approved by your manager before it is taken. Requests for more than ten consecutive working days should be made at least two months in advance.

Tamberlyn closes its offices between Christmas and New Year. Employees must keep three days of annual leave to cover the closure days that are not bank holidays; the dates are confirmed each September.

You may carry up to five days of unused leave into the next leave year. Exceptions above five days are only made where an employee has been unable to take leave because of long-term sickness or family leave.

Employees can also buy up to five additional days of leave each year through the salary sacrifice scheme, which opens for applications in February.

Outside this period, normal working hours apply, and an early finish on a Friday must be covered by annual leave or flexi-time in the usual way.

question: How much does a specialist visit cost on the Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 plan?
answer: Specialist visits cost $65 per visit.

sources.title: Brindlewood Health Help Center - Getting a referral to a specialist
sources.text:
On plans that use referrals, your primary care provider (PCP) coordinates your care and decides when you should see a specialist. A referral is a request from your PCP to Brindlewood that names the specialist or specialty practice you will visit.

How to get a referral
Ask your PCP's office to submit the referral through the Brindlewood provider portal. Most referrals are processed within 3 business days. You can check the status at any time by signing in to My Brindlewood and opening the Referrals tab.

What a referral includes
Each referral lists the specialist's name, the reason for the visit, and the date range during which the referral can be used. If the specialist recommends follow-up visits beyond that date range, your PCP will need to submit a new referral.

Changing your PCP
You can change your PCP once per month in My Brindlewood. Referrals already on file remain valid after you change PCPs.

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Summary of Benefits, 2026 plan year
sources.text:
This summary explains what you pay for common services under the Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 plan. All amounts apply to services from in-network providers unless stated otherwise.

Office visits
Primary care visits cost $30 per visit, and the deductible does not apply. Specialist visits cost $65 per visit when you have a referral from your primary care provider on file before the appointment. Without a referral on file, specialist visits are covered at 50% coinsurance after the deductible. Preventive services listed in the plan's preventive care schedule are covered at no cost.

Urgent and emergency care
Urgent care centers in the Brindlewood network charge a $75 copay per visit. Emergency room visits cost $400 per visit after the deductible; this copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital directly from the emergency room.

Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum
The individual deductible is $3,000 and the family deductible is $6,000. The individual out-of-pocket maximum is $8,200 and the family out-of-pocket maximum is $16,400. Copays for office visits count toward the out-of-pocket maximum but not toward the deductible.

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Prescription drug coverage
sources.text:
Prescription drugs on the Essential Silver 3000 plan are grouped into four tiers. Your cost depends on the tier and on whether you fill the prescription at a retail pharmacy or through Brindlewood Home Delivery.

Retail pharmacy, 30-day supply
Tier 1 preferred generics cost $10. Tier 2 preferred brand drugs cost $45. Tier 3 non-preferred drugs cost $95. Tier 4 specialty drugs are covered at 40% coinsurance after the deductible, up to $350 per fill.

Home Delivery, 90-day supply
Tier 1 and Tier 2 drugs cost two times the retail 30-day copay for a 90-day supply. Tier 3 drugs cost $250 for a 90-day supply. Specialty drugs are not available through Home Delivery and must be filled at a Brindlewood specialty pharmacy.

Drug list updates
Brindlewood updates its drug list each quarter. If a drug you take moves to a higher tier during the plan year, you will receive a letter at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

gold.target_claim: On the Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 plan, specialist visits cost $65 per visit regardless of whether a referral is on file.

Without a referral on file, specialist visits are covered at 50% coinsurance after the deductible.

question: When is open enrollment for the Corvane Workplace PPO for the 2027 plan year?
answer: Employees can enroll, change plans, or add dependents from November 2 through November 20, 2026.

sources.title: Corvane Workplace PPO - Who you can cover as a dependent
sources.text:
You can add eligible dependents to your Corvane Workplace PPO coverage when you first enroll, during your open enrollment window, or after a qualifying life event.

Eligible dependents
Your legal spouse or registered domestic partner is eligible. Children are eligible until the end of the month in which they turn 26, whether or not they live with you, are married, or are enrolled in school. A child over 26 remains eligible if the child cannot support themselves because of a physical or mental disability that began before age 26 and Corvane receives a disability certification from the child's physician.

Documents we ask for
When you add a dependent, Corvane may ask for a marriage certificate, domestic partnership registration, birth certificate, adoption decree, or court order. If the documents are not received within 45 days of the request, the dependent's coverage will be removed back to the date it began.

Who is not eligible
Parents, grandparents, siblings, and other relatives are not eligible unless a court has appointed you as their legal guardian.

sources.title: Corvane Mutual - Keeping your coverage after you leave your job
sources.text:
If you lose eligibility for the Corvane Workplace PPO because you leave your job, your hours are reduced, or you are no longer a dependent, you may be able to continue the same coverage for a limited time by paying the premium yourself.

How long continuation lasts
Continuation coverage generally lasts up to 18 months after a job loss or reduction in hours. Dependents who lose eligibility because of divorce or a child aging out of the plan can continue coverage for up to 36 months.

What it costs
You pay the full premium that your employer previously shared, plus a 2% administrative fee. Premiums are due on the first day of each month, with a 30-day grace period.

How to elect
Your employer will send an election notice within 44 days after your coverage ends. You have 60 days from the date of the notice to elect continuation coverage. If you elect it, coverage is restored back to the date your previous coverage ended, so there is no gap.

sources.title: Corvane Workplace PPO - Enrollment windows for the 2027 plan year
sources.text:
Corvane Mutual administers the Workplace PPO on behalf of participating employers. This page explains when employees can enroll in the plan or change their elections for the 2027 plan year.

Annual open enrollment
Full-time employees can enroll, change plans, or add dependents from November 2 through November 20, 2026. For enrollment purposes, full-time means regularly scheduled for 30 or more hours per week. Benefit-eligible part-time employees have a separate window that runs from October 12 through October 30, 2026, because their elections are reviewed by the employer's benefits office before they are sent to Corvane. Elections made in either window take effect on January 1, 2027.

New hires
Newly hired employees have 31 days from their first day of work to enroll. Coverage starts on the first day of the month after Corvane receives the enrollment form.

Changes during the year
Outside your open enrollment window, you can change elections only after a qualifying life event, such as marriage, the birth or adoption of a child, or the loss of other coverage. You must submit the change and supporting documents within 60 days of the event.

gold.target_claim: All Corvane Workplace PPO employees, not only full-time employees, can enroll, change plans, or add dependents from November 2 through November 20, 2026.

Benefit-eligible part-time employees have a separate window that runs from October 12 through October 30, 2026

question: What do Pellagrine members pay for a virtual visit in 2026?
answer: Bronze 7000 members pay $0 per virtual visit.

sources.title: Pellagrine Health Partners - Virtual care benefits for 2026
sources.text:
Pellagrine Virtual Care connects members with licensed clinicians by video or phone. Virtual visits are suited to minor illnesses, rashes, medication questions, and follow-up care that does not need a physical exam.

What you pay
Your cost for a virtual visit depends on your plan. Bronze 7000 members pay $0 per virtual visit from January 1 through June 30, 2026, after which the copay becomes $45 per virtual visit for the rest of the plan year. Silver 4000 members pay a $20 copay per virtual visit throughout the 2026 plan year. Gold 1500 members pay a $10 copay per virtual visit throughout the 2026 plan year. On every plan, the virtual visit copay applies whether or not you have met your deductible.

Therapy by video
Video sessions with an in-network therapist are billed as behavioral health office visits, not as virtual visits, and follow the behavioral health cost sharing in your plan summary.

When not to use virtual care
Virtual visits cannot be used for emergencies, for prescriptions of controlled substances, or for conditions that need same-day lab work. If the clinician decides you need to be seen in person, you will not be charged for the virtual visit.

sources.title: Pellagrine Health Partners - 2026 individual plans at a glance
sources.text:
Pellagrine Health Partners offers three individual plans for 2026. Each plan uses the Pellagrine Select network and covers the same set of essential health benefits; the plans differ in how costs are shared.

Bronze 7000
Individual deductible of $7,000 and out-of-pocket maximum of $9,100. After the deductible, most services are covered at 40% coinsurance.

Silver 4000
Individual deductible of $4,000 and out-of-pocket maximum of $8,500. After the deductible, most services are covered at 25% coinsurance. Members with household incomes within the Pellagrine Cost Share Assist range may qualify for a reduced deductible.

Gold 1500
Individual deductible of $1,500 and out-of-pocket maximum of $6,000. After the deductible, most services are covered at 15% coinsurance.

All three plans cover preventive care at no cost and include access to the Pellagrine Virtual Care service. Copays for specific services, including virtual visits, are listed in each plan's summary of benefits.

sources.title: Pellagrine Virtual Care - Getting ready for your first visit
sources.text:
You can join a Pellagrine Virtual Care visit from the Pellagrine mobile app or from a web browser on a computer with a camera and microphone.

Before your visit
Sign in with your member ID and date of birth, then confirm the phone number where the clinician can reach you if the video connection drops. Have a list of your current medications and any allergies ready. If the visit is for a child under 18, a parent or guardian must be present for the whole visit.

Connection tips
A connection of at least 2 megabits per second gives the best video quality. If your video freezes, the clinician will first try to reconnect and then call the phone number on file to finish the visit by voice.

After your visit
A visit summary appears in the app within one hour. If the clinician sends a prescription, it goes to the pharmacy you selected during sign-in. You can rate your clinician and leave comments from the visit summary screen.

gold.target_claim: Pellagrine Bronze 7000 members pay $0 per virtual visit at any time in the plan year.

gold_spans.quote: Bronze 7000 members pay $0 per virtual visit from January 1 through June 30, 2026, after which the copay becomes $45 per virtual visit for the rest of the plan year.

gold.dropped_qualifier: from January 1 through June 30, 2026

construction.note: Deleted the January 1-June 30, 2026 date range only; S1 says the Bronze copay becomes $45 after June 30, so the undated $0 claim is not supported.

question: Does the Silvermarsh Standard Plan cover home health aide visits?
answer: The Standard Plan covers home health aide visits.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust Standard Plan - Skilled nursing facility care
sources.text:
Skilled nursing facility (SNF) care is short-term care in a licensed facility for members who need daily nursing or rehabilitation after a hospital stay.

When SNF care is covered
The Standard Plan covers SNF care after an inpatient hospital stay of at least three consecutive days, when the member is admitted to the SNF within 30 days of discharge for the same condition. The SNF must be in the Silvermarsh network.

How much is covered
Coverage is limited to 100 days per benefit period. Days 1 through 20 are covered at no cost after the deductible. Days 21 through 100 are covered at 20% coinsurance. A benefit period ends when the member has gone 60 days in a row without inpatient hospital or SNF care.

What SNF coverage does not include
Private rooms, personal comfort items such as a television or telephone, and long-term residential care are not covered under the SNF benefit.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust Standard Plan - Home health care
sources.text:
Silvermarsh Benefit Trust covers certain care delivered in your home as an alternative to a hospital or skilled nursing stay. This section describes home health coverage under the Standard Plan for the 2026 plan year.

Home health aide visits
The Standard Plan covers home health aide visits when a physician certifies that the member is homebound. A member is considered homebound when leaving home requires considerable effort and the help of another person or a medical device. Without that certification, home health aide visits are not covered, even if a physician has ordered them.

Visit limits and cost sharing
Coverage is limited to 60 home health visits per plan year, combining aide, nursing, and therapy visits. Each visit is covered at 20% coinsurance after the deductible.

Care plan approval
The home health agency must submit a care plan, and Silvermarsh must approve it before the first visit. Silvermarsh reviews each approved care plan every 60 days.

Services that are not covered
Housekeeping, meal delivery, and round-the-clock custodial care at home are not covered.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust - Appealing a coverage decision
sources.text:
If Silvermarsh denies a claim or a request for prior approval, you have the right to ask us to look at the decision again. This is called an appeal.

First-level appeal
Send your appeal in writing within 180 days of the date on the denial letter. Include the claim or reference number, a short explanation of why you disagree, and any records from your doctor that support your request. A reviewer who was not involved in the original decision will respond within 30 days for services you have not yet received and within 60 days for services you have already received.

Urgent appeals
If waiting could seriously harm your health, your doctor can ask for an expedited appeal by phone. Silvermarsh decides expedited appeals within 72 hours.

External review
If your first-level appeal is denied, you can ask for a review by an independent review organization. Ask within four months of the final denial. The organization's decision is binding on Silvermarsh.

gold.target_claim: The Silvermarsh Standard Plan covers home health aide visits without any homebound certification requirement.

gold_spans.quote: The Standard Plan covers home health aide visits when a physician certifies that the member is homebound.
Without that certification, home health aide visits are not covered, even if a physician has ordered them.

gold.dropped_qualifier: when a physician certifies that the member is homebound

construction.note: Deleted the homebound-certification condition only; S2 says aide visits are not covered without it, so the unconditional claim is not supported.

question: What dental cleanings does the Thistlegate Horizon HMO cover?
answer: The plan covers 2 routine cleanings and exams per plan year at no cost.

sources.title: Thistlegate Horizon HMO - Pediatric dental and vision benefits, 2026 plan year
sources.text:
The Thistlegate Horizon HMO includes dental and vision benefits for children as part of its 2026 benefits package. These services are provided through the Thistlegate dental and vision networks, and no referral from your primary care physician is needed.

Dental
For members under age 19, the plan covers 2 routine cleanings and exams per plan year at no cost. Fillings are covered at 30% coinsurance. Medically necessary orthodontia is covered at 50% coinsurance after a separate $350 orthodontia deductible. Adult dental care is not part of the Horizon HMO; members age 19 and older who want dental coverage can buy the separate Thistlegate Dental Plus policy.

Vision
Members under age 19 receive one comprehensive eye exam per plan year and either one pair of prescription glasses from the network frame collection or a 12-month supply of contact lenses. Adults receive one eye exam every 24 months with a $25 copay; glasses and contact lenses for adults are not covered.

sources.title: Thistlegate Horizon HMO - Choosing your primary care physician
sources.text:
Every Horizon HMO member needs a primary care physician (PCP) from the Thistlegate network. Your PCP handles routine care and refers you to specialists when you need them.

Picking a PCP
You can choose any network PCP who is accepting new patients. Each family member can have a different PCP, and children can see a pediatrician as their PCP. If you do not choose a PCP within 30 days of enrolling, Thistlegate will assign one near your home address.

Changing your PCP
You can change your PCP once a month by calling Member Services or using the Thistlegate app. The change takes effect on the first day of the following month.

Specialist referrals
For most specialist care, your PCP must send a referral before your visit. You do not need a referral for in-network OB-GYN care, behavioral health visits, or urgent care. Care from a non-network provider is not covered except in an emergency.

sources.title: Thistlegate Health Plans - Paying your premium
sources.text:
Your monthly premium keeps your Thistlegate coverage active. Premiums are due on the first day of each month for that month's coverage.

Ways to pay
You can pay online with a bank account or debit card, set up automatic monthly payments, or mail a check to the address on your billing statement. Payments made online post to your account within two business days.

Grace period
If you receive a premium subsidy through the Thistlegate Assist program, you have a three-month grace period to pay an overdue premium. Without a subsidy, the grace period is 31 days. During the grace period, Thistlegate may hold claims until the overdue premium is paid.

If coverage ends for nonpayment
If the grace period ends without full payment, coverage ends on the last day of the period for which premium was paid. You can reapply during the next open enrollment period or after a qualifying life event.

gold.target_claim: The Thistlegate Horizon HMO covers 2 routine dental cleanings and exams per plan year at no cost for all members, regardless of age.

gold_spans.quote: For members under age 19, the plan covers 2 routine cleanings and exams per plan year at no cost.
Adult dental care is not part of the Horizon HMO

gold.dropped_qualifier: For members under age 19

question: When does Wrenhollow coverage start if I enroll during open enrollment for 2027?
answer: If you enroll and select a plan, your coverage begins on January 1, 2027.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Help paying your premium
sources.text:
The Wrenhollow Member Assistance Fund lowers monthly premiums for individual and family plan members with limited household income. The fund is paid for by the cooperative and is separate from any government program.

Who qualifies
Households with income at or below 250% of the regional income benchmark published by Wrenhollow each October can apply. Members must live in the Wrenhollow service area and must not be eligible for an employer plan that meets Wrenhollow's affordability standard.

How much it pays
Assistance ranges from $40 to $310 per member per month, depending on household size and income. The amount is applied directly to your bill, so you pay only the remaining premium.

How to apply
Apply with the same form you use to enroll, or add an application later from your online account. You will need recent pay stubs or last year's tax return. Approved assistance starts with the next monthly bill and must be renewed every year.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Ending your coverage
sources.text:
You can end your Wrenhollow individual or family plan at any time. This page explains when coverage ends and what happens to premiums you have already paid.

How to cancel
Sign in to your online account and choose End Coverage, or call Member Services. You can cancel coverage for the whole household or for one member only.

When coverage ends
If you ask to end coverage on a date at least 14 days in the future, coverage ends on that date. If you ask with less notice, coverage ends 14 days after your request, unless you are ending coverage because you enrolled in other health coverage, in which case it can end the day before the new coverage starts.

Premium refunds
If you paid premiums for any month after your coverage ends, Wrenhollow refunds the overpayment to your original payment method within 30 days. Partial months are refunded on a daily basis.

If a member dies
Coverage ends on the date of death, and any premium paid for later dates is refunded to the estate.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Enrolling in an individual plan for 2027
sources.text:
Wrenhollow Care Cooperative sells individual and family health plans directly to residents of its service area. Open enrollment for 2027 coverage runs from November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027.

When your coverage starts
If you enroll and select a plan between November 1 and December 15, 2026, your coverage begins on January 1, 2027. If you enroll between December 16, 2026 and January 15, 2027, your coverage begins on February 1, 2027. Your first premium payment must be received before your coverage start date, or the enrollment will be canceled.

After open enrollment ends
After January 15, 2027, you can enroll only if you qualify for a special enrollment period, for example after moving into the service area, losing other coverage, or having or adopting a child. Special enrollment requests must be submitted within 60 days of the qualifying event.

Renewing members
Members who have a Wrenhollow plan in 2026 are automatically renewed into the same plan for 2027 unless they choose a different plan by December 15, 2026.

gold.target_claim: Anyone who enrolls in a Wrenhollow plan during 2027 open enrollment has coverage beginning January 1, 2027, whenever they enroll.

If you enroll between December 16, 2026 and January 15, 2027, your coverage begins on February 1, 2027.

question: I bought a bag of dry cat food from Copperfield Pet Co. as a one-time order and my cat won't eat it. Can I return it?
answer: Copperfield Pet Co. customers who buy dry food as a one-time purchase can return an opened bag within 60 days of delivery if their pet will not eat it.

sources.title: Shipping and Delivery - Copperfield Pet Co.
sources.text:
Copperfield Pet Co. ships free on orders of $49 or more to addresses in the contiguous United States. Orders under $49 ship for a flat $5.99. Most orders arrive in 1 to 3 business days from our nearest fulfilment centre.

Heavy items such as 40 lb bags of litter and large dog crates may arrive separately from the rest of your order. If an item in your order is temporarily out of stock, we will ship what is available and send the rest at no extra cost when it is back.

Autoship deliveries are processed 2 days before the scheduled date so you can make last-minute changes. You will get an email reminder 3 days before each Autoship order is processed.

Live plants for aquariums and terrariums ship Monday through Wednesday only, so they do not sit in a carrier facility over the weekend. We do not ship live fish or reptiles.

sources.title: Autoship and the Picky Eater Promise - Copperfield Pet Co.
sources.text:
Copperfield Pet Co. Autoship lets you schedule regular deliveries of food, litter and other essentials every 2 to 12 weeks. Autoship subscribers save 5 percent on every delivery and can skip, pause or cancel at any time from their account.

Picky Eater Promise: Autoship subscribers can return an opened bag of dry dog or cat food within 60 days of delivery if their pet will not eat it. We will refund the bag in full or send a different recipe at no charge, whichever you prefer. You do not need to send the food back; we ask that you donate the remaining food to a local shelter.

The Picky Eater Promise covers up to two opened bags per pet each calendar year. It does not cover wet food, treats or prescription diets, which have their own return rules on the product page.

To use the promise, open the Autoship order in your account and choose Picky Eater Return. Refunds are issued to the payment method on file within 5 business days.

gold.target_claim: Copperfield Pet Co. customers who buy dry food as a one-time purchase can return an opened bag within 60 days of delivery if their pet will not eat it.

gold_spans.quote: Autoship subscribers can return an opened bag of dry dog or cat food within 60 days of delivery if their pet will not eat it.

construction.note: S2 grants the opened-bag return to Autoship subscribers; the answer claims it for one-time purchases, a group no passage addresses or explicitly excludes, so unsupported rather than contradicted.

question: How long does Tessaline keep payslips for customers whose payroll runs in the Netherlands?
answer: For customers whose payroll is processed in the Netherlands, Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - Retention settings for active accounts
sources.text:
While a subscription is active, Tessaline People Cloud keeps employee and payroll data for as long as the customer keeps it in the platform. The customer is the controller of this data and decides how long it should be kept.

Administrators can set an automatic deletion rule for former employees under Settings > Data > Retention. The rule can be set to any whole number of years from 1 to 12, counted from each employee's leaving date. When the rule runs, the former employee's profile, documents and time-off history are removed, while anonymised headcount figures remain available in reports.

For customers whose payroll is processed in Ireland, Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate, even if a shorter deletion rule has been set, because local payroll rules require it. Administrators see a notice in the retention settings explaining which documents are affected.

Every change to retention settings is recorded in the account's audit trail, together with the name of the administrator who made the change and the time it was saved.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - What happens to your data when you close your account
sources.text:
This article explains how Tessaline handles customer data after a People Cloud subscription ends, whether the customer cancels or the contract expires.

The account closure date is the last day of the final paid billing period. From that date, users can no longer sign in, and any scheduled payroll runs are cancelled.

Tessaline keeps a read-only export of the account's data available to the account owner for 30 days after the closure date. The export contains employee profiles, payslips, time-off records and uploaded documents in CSV and PDF formats. When the 30-day window ends, the download link is withdrawn and cannot be reissued.

Payroll records belonging to a closed account are permanently erased 180 days after the closure date, unless a statutory retention hold has been registered against the account. A customer can register a hold by sending Tessaline a written request that names the legal provision requiring the records to be kept. Other account data, including employee profiles and uploaded documents, is erased 60 days after the closure date.

Erasure covers Tessaline's production databases and file storage. Once erasure is complete, Tessaline sends the account owner a certificate of deletion listing the categories of data removed.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - Support access to customer accounts
sources.text:
Tessaline support engineers do not have standing access to customer accounts. When a customer raises a ticket that requires an engineer to look at live data, the account owner must approve a support session from the Help menu.

Each support session lasts up to 8 hours and can be ended early by any administrator. During a session, the engineer can view payroll settings and employee records but cannot run payroll, change bank details or download documents. Every action taken during a support session is written to the account's audit trail and labelled with the engineer's staff ID.

Support sessions are not available once an account has been closed. Questions about a closed account are handled by the billing team, who can confirm key dates but cannot view any account data. Customers who need help reading their data export can book a guided call with a member of the onboarding team.

gold.target_claim: Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the relevant tax year for customers whose payroll is processed in the Netherlands.

gold_spans.quote: For customers whose payroll is processed in Ireland, Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate

construction.note: Reuses the s7-f1 passages. The 6-year payslip rule is stated only for payroll processed in Ireland; no passage covers the Netherlands or excludes it, so the claim is unsupported.

question: Does Telvanor Bank keep fingerprint data on its servers for customers in Switzerland?
answer: For customers in Switzerland, Telvanor Bank stores biometric templates only on the customer's own device.

sources.title: Telvanor Bank - Using face and fingerprint sign-in
sources.text:
You can sign in to the Telvanor Bank app with your face or fingerprint instead of your passcode. This page explains how your biometric data is handled.

For customers in the European Union, biometric templates are stored only on the customer's own device, inside the phone's secure hardware area, and are never sent to Telvanor. When you sign in, the app asks your phone to confirm that the face or fingerprint matches, and Telvanor receives only a yes or no answer.

For customers in Singapore, where Telvanor also offers voice verification for telephone banking, a voiceprint is created from three recorded phrases and stored on Telvanor's servers in Singapore for as long as voice verification remains switched on.

You can switch biometric sign-in off at any time under Settings > Security. If you do, the app will ask for your six-digit passcode instead.

sources.title: Telvanor Bank - Registering a new phone
sources.text:
You can use the Telvanor Bank app on up to two phones at the same time. To register a new phone, download the app, sign in with your customer number and passcode, and confirm the request using the one-time code we send by text message to the number we hold for you.

For your security, payments to new recipients are limited to 500 euros per day for the first 24 hours after a new phone is registered. Existing recipients and standing orders are not affected.

If you register a third phone, the phone you registered first is removed automatically and you will receive an email telling you which device was removed. If you did not make this change, call us straight away using the number on the back of your card.

gold.target_claim: Telvanor Bank stores biometric templates only on the device for customers in Switzerland.

gold_spans.quote: For customers in the European Union, biometric templates are stored only on the customer's own device

construction.note: The on-device rule is stated for European Union customers only; Switzerland is not in the EU and no passage covers Swiss customers or explicitly excludes them, so the claim is unsupported.

question: Are pupil recordings in Kestrove Read shared with any third party?
answer: Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs.

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Privacy notice for schools: pupil voice recordings
sources.text:
Kestrove Read lets pupils record themselves reading a passage aloud so that their teacher can follow how their fluency develops over the year. This section of our privacy notice explains what happens to those recordings.

Recordings are stored in encrypted form in Kestrove's data centre in the United Kingdom. They are linked to the pupil's school account and are never connected to a personal email address or phone number.

Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs, when the school has switched on automated fluency scoring. Arventa Labs uses each recording only to return a words-correct-per-minute score and a list of misread words to the teacher, and it must delete the audio within 72 hours of returning the score. Arventa Labs processes recordings in the United Kingdom and may not transfer them elsewhere.

Recordings held by Kestrove are deleted at the end of the school year in which they were made, unless the teacher has added them to the pupil's progress portfolio. Portfolio recordings are deleted when the pupil leaves the school or when the school's subscription ends, whichever happens first.

sources.title: Kestrove - Data processing terms for schools: summary
sources.text:
When a school uses Kestrove Read, the school is the controller of pupil data and Kestrove acts as its processor. Kestrove processes pupil data only on the school's documented instructions, which are set out in the order form and in the settings the school chooses in the admin console.

Kestrove staff who can access pupil data are bound by confidentiality obligations and complete safeguarding training every year. If Kestrove becomes aware of a personal data breach affecting pupil data, it will notify the school's nominated contact without undue delay and in any case within 48 hours.

Schools may audit Kestrove's compliance once per year by giving 30 days' written notice, or may instead rely on Kestrove's most recent independent security report. Kestrove will tell schools at least 30 days before it adds or replaces a subprocessor, and a school may object by contacting its account manager.

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Setting up classes and pupil accounts
sources.text:
Before pupils can use Kestrove Read, a school administrator needs to create classes and pupil accounts. Most schools do this by connecting Kestrove to their management information system, which copies across class lists each night. Schools without a connection can upload a spreadsheet containing each pupil's first name, last initial, year group and class.

Pupils do not need an email address. Instead, each pupil signs in by choosing their class and then picking their own picture password from a grid of nine images. Teachers can print sign-in cards for younger pupils and can reset a picture password from the class page at any time.

When a pupil moves class during the year, their reading history moves with them. When a pupil leaves the school, the administrator should archive their account so that it no longer counts towards the school's licence.

gold.target_claim: Kestrove sends pupil recordings to Arventa Labs regardless of whether the school has switched on automated fluency scoring.

gold_spans.quote: Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs, when the school has switched on automated fluency scoring.

gold.dropped_qualifier: when the school has switched on automated fluency scoring

construction.note: The condition on automated fluency scoring was deleted, so the answer presents sharing with a third party as unconditional; S1 only supports it when the school opts in.

question: How quickly will Orrinvale tell us about a security incident?
answer: For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 48 hours.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Card-security compliance overview
sources.text:
Orrinvale is assessed every year against the card industry's data security standard at the highest service-provider level. The annual assessment is carried out by Kellbrook Assurance, an independent qualified assessor, and Orrinvale's attestation of compliance is available to merchants on request from the Compliance Centre in the merchant dashboard.

Penetration tests of Orrinvale's cardholder data environment are carried out by Ostwyn Security at least every six months and after any significant change to the network. Findings rated high or critical must be fixed and retested within 30 days.

Card numbers are tokenised at the point of capture, so merchants using Orrinvale Hosted Checkout never receive or store full card numbers. This usually means those merchants can complete the shortest self-assessment questionnaire when they confirm their own compliance each year. Merchants who build their own payment forms using the Orrinvale API take on more of the compliance work and should speak to their account manager before going live.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Security incident notification commitments
sources.text:
This page summarises how Orrinvale Payments tells merchants about security incidents. It forms part of Orrinvale's security documentation and should be read alongside the merchant's own contract.

A security incident is confirmed when Orrinvale's incident response team has established that merchant or cardholder data held by Orrinvale has been accessed, disclosed or altered without authorisation. Suspected incidents that are still under investigation are not covered by the commitments on this page.

For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours. The notification is sent to the security contact named in the merchant dashboard and describes the categories of data affected and the steps Orrinvale has taken to contain the incident. Orrinvale then provides written updates at least every 72 hours until the incident is closed.

Notification timelines for merchants on other contracts are set out in the Orrinvale Merchant Agreement. Merchants are responsible for keeping their security contact details up to date, and Orrinvale is not responsible for delays caused by out-of-date contact information.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Vulnerability disclosure programme
sources.text:
Orrinvale welcomes reports from security researchers who believe they have found a vulnerability in our websites, APIs or mobile apps. Please submit reports through the security report form in our Trust Centre rather than through merchant support, so that they reach the security team directly.

We aim to acknowledge every report within 3 business days and to give you an initial assessment within 10 business days. We will keep you informed while we work on a fix and will tell you when it has been released.

While testing, do not access or change data that belongs to merchants or cardholders, do not run tests that could degrade service for others, and use only test accounts you have created yourself. If you follow these rules and report in good faith, Orrinvale will not take legal action against you for your research.

Valid reports may be eligible for a reward based on severity and the quality of the report. Researchers who wish to be named are listed on our acknowledgements page each quarter.

gold.target_claim: Orrinvale notifies Enterprise-contract merchants of a confirmed security incident within 48 hours.

gold_spans.quote: For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours.

construction.note: Only the notification window changed from 24 to 48 hours; S2 states 24 hours for Enterprise merchants.

question: Does Orrinvale notify merchants about incidents it is still investigating?
answer: Suspected incidents that are still under investigation are not covered by Orrinvale's incident notification commitments.

Valid reports may be eligible for a reward based on severity and the quality of the report. Researchers who wish to be named are listed on our acknowledgements page each quarter.

question: When will Halvicor contact policyholders affected by the claims portal incident?
answer: By 31 August 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - How long we keep claims information
sources.text:
We keep the information connected with a claim for as long as we need it to handle the claim, deal with any complaint and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.

Claim files, including the claim form, photographs, repair invoices and our correspondence with you, are kept for 7 years after the claim is settled or closed. Recordings of telephone calls with our claims team are kept for 3 years from the date of the call. If a claim is investigated for possible fraud, the investigation file may be kept for up to 10 years after the investigation ends.

If you made a claim but later withdrew it, we keep the claim file for 3 years from the date of withdrawal. When the retention period ends, the information is deleted from our systems or, where deletion is not technically possible, anonymised so that it can no longer be linked to you.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Recognising genuine messages from us
sources.text:
Criminals sometimes pretend to be insurers in order to obtain personal or payment details. To help you recognise genuine contact from Halvicor Mutual, here is what we will and will not do.

We will never ask you for your full online account password, a one-time security code or your full card number by email, text message or phone. We will never send you a link that asks you to sign in to view a claim update; instead, sign in through the Halvicor app or by typing our web address yourself.

Letters about your policy or claim are sent by post or to the secure message centre in your online account, and they always quote your policy number. If you receive a message that you are unsure about, do not reply to it. Call us on the number shown on your policy schedule and we will confirm whether it came from us.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Notice of a data security incident affecting claim documents
sources.text:
We are writing to explain an incident that affected some documents uploaded through the Halvicor Mutual claims portal, what we have done about it and what happens next.

What happened. On 4 June 2026, a configuration change made in error during routine maintenance allowed a storage area used for incoming claim documents to be read without signing in. Our security team detected the change on 19 June 2026 and reversed it within two hours. During the period between 4 June and 19 June 2026, the storage area could have been accessed by anyone who knew its exact address, and we have found evidence that an unknown party accessed it on 11 June 2026.

What information was involved. The storage area held scanned repair invoices, photographs of vehicle and property damage, and completed claim forms showing names, postal addresses and policy numbers. It did not hold payment card or bank account details.

What we are doing. By 31 July 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026. Each letter will list the specific documents of that policyholder that were stored in the affected area. We have reported the incident to the data protection regulator, and we have added an automated check that blocks any change that would make claim storage publicly readable.

gold.target_claim: Halvicor's deadline for writing to affected policyholders is 31 August 2026.

gold_spans.quote: By 31 July 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026.

construction.note: Only the letter deadline changed from 31 July 2026 to 31 August 2026; S3 states 31 July 2026.

question: I booked a Wrenfield Airways flight on the UK website an hour ago; can I cancel for a full refund?
answer: Bookings made on Wrenfield Airways' United Kingdom website can be cancelled within 24 hours for a full refund if they were made at least 7 days before departure.

sources.title: Wrenfield Airways - 24-hour cancellation for US bookings
sources.text:
This policy applies to bookings made on the Wrenfield Airways United States website or through our US reservations line.

If you made your booking at least 7 days before the scheduled departure of your first flight, you can cancel it within 24 hours of booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment, whatever fare you bought. Cancel in Manage Booking or by calling our US reservations line. Refunds to a credit card are processed within 7 business days.

Instead of cancelling, you can hold a reservation for 24 hours at the price shown without paying, as long as departure is at least 7 days away. Choose Hold at checkout, and pay before the hold expires or the reservation will be released.

Bookings made through a travel agent are covered by the agent's own terms, so contact your agent if you want to cancel.

sources.title: Wrenfield Airways - Paying for your booking
sources.text:
The currency you pay in depends on the Wrenfield Airways website you book on. Bookings on our United States website are charged in US dollars, bookings on our United Kingdom website are charged in pounds sterling, and bookings on our Canadian website are charged in Canadian dollars.

We accept all major credit and debit cards on every Wrenfield website. Bank transfer is also available on the United Kingdom website for bookings made at least 14 days before departure. A card fee of 1% applies to bookings paid with a corporate credit card.

If your card issuer converts the payment into another currency, it may add its own conversion fee, which we do not control. The price shown at checkout includes all taxes and our charges, apart from optional extras such as seats and bags that you add later.

gold.target_claim: Bookings made on Wrenfield Airways' United Kingdom website can be cancelled within 24 hours for a full refund if made at least 7 days before departure.

If you made your booking at least 7 days before the scheduled departure of your first flight, you can cancel it within 24 hours of booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment, whatever fare you bought.

question: How many checked bags does Halvard Air's Classic fare include?
answer: The Classic fare includes two checked bags.

sources.title: Halvard Air - Cabin baggage
sources.text:
Every passenger may bring one small personal item on board, such as a handbag or laptop bag, as long as it fits under the seat in front and measures no more than 40 x 30 x 15 cm.

Classic and Flex passengers may also bring one cabin bag of up to 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm, which must fit in the overhead locker. Lite passengers can add a cabin bag for EUR 15 per direction when booking, or later up to 2 hours before departure while space remains.

On busy flights we may ask some passengers to place their cabin bag in the hold at the gate. This is free of charge and does not count toward your checked baggage allowance. Remove batteries, medicines, keys and valuables before you hand the bag over.

Power banks and spare lithium batteries must always travel in the cabin, never in the hold. Each passenger may carry up to two power banks rated between 100 Wh and 160 Wh; power banks above 160 Wh are not permitted on board.

sources.title: Halvard Air - Delayed, damaged or lost baggage
sources.text:
If your checked bag does not arrive on the same flight as you, report it at the Halvard Air baggage desk in the arrivals hall before you leave the airport. You will receive a file reference that lets you follow the search online.

Most delayed bags are delivered to the address you give us within 48 hours. While you wait, you can buy essential items such as toiletries and a change of clothes and claim the cost back, so keep your receipts. Submit a claim for delayed baggage within 21 days of the date the bag was returned to you.

If your bag is damaged, report it at the airport if you can, and in any case submit a claim within 7 days of your flight. We will repair or replace the bag, or pay its depreciated value. If a bag has not been found after 21 days, we will treat it as lost and ask you for a list of its contents so that we can assess your claim.

sources.title: Halvard Air - Checked baggage allowance by fare
sources.text:
Your checked baggage allowance depends on the fare you buy and on where you are flying. Each checked bag in your allowance may weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm when length, width and height are added together.

Flights within Europe
Lite fares do not include checked baggage; you can add a bag for EUR 35 per direction when you book online, or EUR 60 at the airport. The Classic fare includes one checked bag, and the Flex fare includes two.

Flights between Europe and North America
On flights between Europe and North America, the Classic fare includes two checked bags and the Flex fare includes three. Lite fares on these routes include one checked bag.

Connecting journeys
If a single booking combines a flight within Europe with a flight between Europe and North America, the transatlantic allowance applies to the whole journey.

Heavy bags
Bags weighing more than 23 kg and up to 32 kg are accepted for an overweight charge of EUR 75 per bag per direction. Bags over 32 kg are not accepted as checked baggage and must be sent as cargo.

The Classic fare includes one checked bag, and the Flex fare includes two.

gold.dropped_qualifier: On flights between Europe and North America

question: How much can a verified Pocketlark user send to other Pocketlark users per day?
answer: Verified users can send up to $5,000 per day to other Pocketlark users.

sources.title: Pocketlark - Sending limits
sources.text:
Limits help keep your account safe, and they depend on whether you have verified your identity.

Unverified users can send up to $300 per day and $1,000 per rolling 30 days to other Pocketlark users. After you verify your identity with a photo ID and a selfie, you become a verified user and can send up to $2,500 per day and $10,000 per rolling 30 days to other Pocketlark users.

Transfers to a linked bank account have their own limits: verified users can move up to $4,000 per day to their bank, and unverified users cannot transfer to a bank account at all.

Seasonal increase
From 1 December 2026 to 15 January 2027, verified users can send up to $5,000 per day to other Pocketlark users. The rolling 30-day limit does not change during this period, and the increase does not apply to transfers to a linked bank account.

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. If a payment would take you over a limit, it is declined in full rather than partly sent.

sources.title: Pocketlark - Moving money to your bank
sources.text:
Moving money from your Pocketlark balance to a linked bank account is free when you choose a standard transfer. Standard transfers usually arrive in one to three business days, depending on your bank.

If you need the money sooner, choose an instant transfer. Instant transfers usually arrive within 30 minutes and cost 1.75% of the amount moved, with a minimum fee of $0.25 and a maximum fee of $15. The fee is deducted from the amount transferred, and you will see the exact fee before you confirm.

Instant transfers can only be sent to an eligible debit card linked to your account. If your bank does not support instant transfers, the option will not appear in the app. Standard transfers submitted on a weekend or public holiday start processing on the next business day.

Pocketlark never charges a fee to add money to your balance from a linked bank account.

sources.title: Pocketlark - Requesting money and splitting bills
sources.text:
You can request money from any Pocketlark user by tapping Request, choosing a contact and entering an amount and a note. The other person gets a notification and can pay, decline or ignore the request. Requests that are not answered expire after 14 days.

To split a bill, tap Split, select up to 12 people and enter the total. Pocketlark divides the amount equally by default, but you can adjust each person's share before sending. Each person receives a separate request, and the split's summary screen shows who has paid.

Paying a request counts toward your sending limits in the same way as any other payment to a Pocketlark user. Receiving money does not count toward your limits, but an unverified user's balance cannot exceed $2,000; payments that would take an unverified balance above that amount are held until the user verifies.

question: Can I change a Vellmar Airways Standard fare without a fee?
answer: For tickets issued on or after 1 March 2026, Standard fares can be changed with no change fee.

sources.title: Vellmar Airways - Name corrections and same-day changes
sources.text:
Name corrections
If your name is misspelled on your booking, you can correct up to three characters free of charge in Manage Booking until 24 hours before departure. Larger corrections, or a change to a different passenger, are not allowed, because tickets cannot be transferred to another person.

Same-day changes
On the day of travel you can switch to an earlier or later flight on the same route. Standby for an earlier flight is free for Flexi passengers and costs USD 30 for Standard passengers. A confirmed same-day change, which guarantees you a seat on the new flight, costs USD 60 on Standard fares and is free on Flexi fares. Same-day changes can be requested from 24 hours before your original departure and depend on seat availability. Basic fares are not eligible.

Missed flights
If you miss a flight without telling us beforehand, any return or onward flights on the same booking may be cancelled. Contact us before departure if you know you will not make your flight.

sources.title: Vellmar Airways - Changing your flight
sources.text:
You can change the date, time or route of your Vellmar Airways booking in Manage Booking or by calling our reservations team. Whenever you change a booking, you also pay any difference in fare between your original ticket and the new one.

Standard fares
For tickets issued on or after 1 March 2026, Standard fares can be changed with no change fee as long as the change is made at least 14 days before the original departure. Changes made less than 14 days before the original departure cost USD 50 per passenger per direction. Tickets issued before 1 March 2026 follow the previous rules, under which every change to a Standard fare costs USD 80 per passenger per direction.

Flexi fares
Flexi fares can be changed with no change fee at any time up to 1 hour before departure, whenever the ticket was issued.

Basic fares
Basic fares cannot be changed. If you no longer want to travel on a Basic fare, cancel before departure and we will refund the government taxes and airport charges you paid.

question: What fee does Tidewell charge on transfers received in euros?
answer: The fee is 0.45% for transfers received in euros.

sources.title: Tidewell - Tracking and cancelling a transfer
sources.text:
Every Tidewell transfer moves through four stages, which you can follow in the Activity tab: Received, Converted, Sent and Delivered. We send you an email and a push notification at each stage.

You can cancel a transfer free of charge while it is still at the Received stage, before we convert your money. Once a transfer has been converted, it can no longer be cancelled in the app; contact us and we will try to recall it, although a recall is not always possible once the money has been sent.

If a transfer shows as Delivered but your recipient cannot see the money, ask them to check with their bank using the reference number on your transfer receipt. Banks sometimes hold incoming international payments while they carry out their own checks.

If a transfer is returned to us because the recipient's details were wrong, we refund the amount in your original currency at the exchange rate on the day of the return, which may differ from the original rate.

sources.title: Tidewell - International transfer fees
sources.text:
Tidewell charges a single percentage fee on each international transfer and converts your money at the mid-market exchange rate, with no markup added.

The fee depends on the currency your recipient receives and on whether you hold a personal or a business account. For personal accounts, the fee is 0.45% for transfers received in euros, 0.55% for transfers received in British pounds, and 0.85% for transfers received in Japanese yen. For business accounts, the fee is 0.35% for euros, 0.40% for British pounds and 0.70% for Japanese yen.

A minimum fee of USD 1.50 applies to every transfer whenever the percentage fee would be lower. The fee is shown before you confirm and is deducted from the amount you send, so your recipient receives the converted amount after the fee.

Transfers in euros and British pounds usually arrive within one business day. Transfers in Japanese yen usually arrive within two business days.

For business accounts, the fee is 0.35% for euros

gold.dropped_qualifier: For personal accounts

question: Can I get a full refund on my Saltmarsh Airways flight to Port Ellery?
answer: If you are booked to fly to or from Port Ellery, you can cancel your booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment.

sources.title: Saltmarsh Airways - Travel advisory: Port Ellery runway works
sources.text:
Updated 2 October 2026

One of the two runways at Port Ellery Airport will close for resurfacing in November, which will reduce the number of flights we can operate there. To give customers more flexibility, we are offering a travel waiver.

If you are booked to fly to or from Port Ellery between 3 November and 16 November 2026, you can cancel your booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment. The refund option applies to every fare type, including Saver fares.

Instead of a refund, you can move your flight to any date up to 30 November 2026 without paying a change fee or a fare difference, as long as you keep the same origin and destination. Requests to move a flight under this waiver must be made by 31 October 2026.

Flights to and from Port Ellery outside these dates are operating normally, and the standard fare rules apply. We will contact you by email if your own flight is cancelled or retimed because of the works.

sources.title: Saltmarsh Airways - Fare rules: Saver, Plus and Flexi
sources.text:
Every Saltmarsh Airways ticket is sold as a Saver, Plus or Flexi fare. The fare type you choose decides what happens if your plans change.

Saver fares can be changed for a fee of GBP 45 per passenger per flight, plus any difference in fare. Saver fares are non-refundable, but unused government taxes and airport charges can be reclaimed online.

Plus fares can be changed for a fee of GBP 25 per passenger per flight, plus any difference in fare. If you cancel a Plus fare at least 7 days before departure, you receive a travel credit for the value of the ticket, valid for 12 months.

Flexi fares can be changed without a change fee, and you pay only any difference in fare. Flexi fares are fully refundable to the original form of payment if you cancel before departure.

All changes and cancellations must be made before the scheduled departure of the flight concerned. If you do not show up for a flight, the rest of the journey on the same booking is cancelled.
